title: Choose the visual world
question: Fresh hand. The roll assigned Registry Room for the new app shell — keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Registry Room
options.lineage: the CA firm's record almirah and inward/outward register
options.thesis: The workspace is the firm's record room: steel drawers of tied client folders, ruled against a bound inward/outward register.
options.viewport: A steel drawer column down the left for the firm's sections, one ruled register sheet carrying the working rows, a token-slip rail for open items, and a wide annotation margin holding cross-reference ticks and stamps.
options.risk: Reads institutional and cold if the register ruling and the red tape stop doing real work.

raised.raise: One integer scale rules every dimension and figure — nothing sits off-grid, and the palette is a fixed law rather than a mood.
Every cross-reference is a leader line back to its source document, and the page's structure follows the reference network, not decorative panels.
A wide persistent annotation margin holds the apparatus — ticks, brackets, stamps — and absorbs width before the register sheds a column.

options.label: Accounts Workstation
options.thesis: The shell behaves like the accounting software the firm already trusts: menu bar, dockable panes, a ledger tree, and a keyboard footer.
options.viewport: A menu bar and command footer bracketing three docked panes: a ledger tree, a dense working grid, and a detail panel — keyboard-first, no pointer required.
options.risk: The familiar one — the direction most runs in this category land on.

options.label: Cutting-Bench Rail
options.lineage: film cutting bench and its perforated select rail
options.thesis: Every document is a frame pinned to one perforated rail, and the stage you stopped at is flagged.
options.viewport: One perforated rail crosses the sheet, frames strung along it in stage order, deferred items hanging on pins below, the stopped frame flagged in orange.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — a parsing pipeline is a select rail — and loses narrowly on identification.
options.risk: The scrub-only rail fights a wide desktop workspace with parallel columns.

options.label: CD-ROM Console
options.thesis: The app is a fixed rendered machine: embossed toggles ranged around one bright working window.
options.viewport: A fixed console frame with beveled section toggles and a single bright window carrying the working data.
options.case: Holds identification through native-feeling desktop chrome, and clarity through hard-framed navigation.
options.risk: Reads nostalgic novelty when the bevels stop signalling real press states.

options.label: Arcade Pixel Glow
options.thesis: The tool renders as a sixteen-colour sprite stage on phosphor black.
options.viewport: Eight-by-eight pixel caps along the top edge over a whole-tile playfield.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the tile grid costs legibility on long financial columns.
options.kept: Strict palette law and an integer scale nothing is allowed off.
options.risk: Reads playful where the firm needs authority.

options.label: Tensegrity Force Column
options.thesis: Layout obeys a real network of tension and compression paths between records.
options.viewport: Floating members joined by cords, force values labelled on leader lines.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a force network obscures a straight reconciliation table.
options.kept: Annotations pinned to nodes on leader lines, and layout that follows real structure.
options.risk: The spatial network collapses into noise at realdense row counts.

options.label: Reference-Setting Page
options.lineage: wide-margin reference edition ruled by a ruling engine
options.thesis: Two short-measure columns twin around a centre key rail inside a wide annotation margin.
options.viewport: A small dense block held in a wide margin where apparatus hangs over the edge.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a reading page under-serves a operate surface's scanning task.
options.kept: The wide annotation margin where apparatus hangs and overlaps the block.
options.risk: The two-column measure wastes a wide desktop window.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The icon-rail SaaS dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left icon rail, top bar, a KPI card grid over a data table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
